positions.title: Small Business Consultant
positions.description:
Investigated and recommended potential vertical markets during the companies expansion phase. Developed business plans for entry into each potential market. 

Gained experience in developing materials relating to an investment raise. Directed the company as to how it can best serve the community as a social business. Advised on and developed promotional and marketing material.

positions.title: Social Business Consultant
positions.description: Worked and lived directly with a family to help develop their small holder permaculture farm. Advised the family on financial decisions, long-term planning, and marketing strategy. Met with contacts within the community to understand the needs of Fijian farmers as a whole.

positions.title: Office Management Specialist
positions.description: Developed databases in Microsoft Access for the embassy that kept track of maintenance issues with the U.S. Government's properties and background investigation information. Assisted in the preparation of workshops and presented in meetings relating to security matters in Haiti.
